# Repository instructions — Disabled Proceed Until Completed

## Shortcut

`D P u C` means **Disabled Proceed Until Completed**. It is an invocation to continue the latest unfinished, explicitly authorized repository task with an accessibility-first, low-interaction workflow.

## Behavior

- Resume the most recent unfinished task instead of asking the user to restate it.
- Continue safe, in-scope, reversible work through verified milestones.
- Use an existing review branch where appropriate and minimize repeated confirmations.
- Do not infer authorization for unrelated repositories, protected-branch merges, production deployments, destructive edits, spending, secrets, or access changes.
- At a genuine platform/tool boundary, preserve exact evidence and provide a concise handoff instead of claiming success.
- Recheck live branch, commit, tests, and CI before reporting completion.

This shortcut does not create automatic sessions, bypass platform confirmations, or promise unattended background execution.
